paragraphs.text: This Psalm was made as a prayer to desire God to be merciful to the ten tribes.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Move their hearts, that they may return to worship God properly, that is, in the place you have appointed.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Join your whole people, and all your tribes together again.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: The faithful fear God's anger, when they perceive that their prayers are not heard immediately.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: angry against the prayer of thy

paragraphs.text: Our neighbours have continual strife and war against us.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Because recompence only comes from God, they most instantly and repeatedly call on God for it is a means by which they shall be saved.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Seeing that from your mercy you have made us a most dear possession to you, and we through our sins are made open for wild beasts to devour us, declare again my love and finish the work that you have begun.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, they who hate our religion, as well as they who hate our persons.
paragraphs.label: i
paragraphs.anchor: boar out of the wood doth

paragraphs.text: They gave no place to temptation, knowing that even though there was no help in earth, yet God was able to help them from heaven.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: So that no power can prevail against it, and which as a young bud you raised up again as out of the burnt ashes.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: Only when you are angry and not of the sword of the enemy.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: That is, on this vine or people, whom you have planted with your right hand, that they should be as one man or one body
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: For no one can call on God but such as are raised up as it were from death to life, and regenerate by the Holy Spirit.
paragraphs.label: o
